text: - **The 0.2.0 sweep test's reach:** its leg check reads `.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh` as one whole text by `contains`, so a named target dropped from the `stand-repeat` leg alone reads green while the `a11y` leg still names it — only both sites removed read red (`--test select_interaction` at .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:39 and .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:57) — and stand-repeat membership is held jointly with `.github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py`'s `test_stand_repeat_leg_runs_three_rounds`, which asserts `select_interaction` among that leg's logged words, and five more of the targets the leg names (.github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:361-368); the gap's fix is owned by a `CARRY:` on the 0.3.0 working route's Stand requirement sweep entry — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-26-codebase-health/report.md (evidence/row-controls.md)

subject: scope-entities
text: - **Served pages and the stand's unit tests:** `tests/blitz-tests` holds two checks on the pages the stand serves beside the lean four, each declaring `mod session_common;` and no `mod fixtures;`, each test in both layout modes, picked up by `run stand` and the stand-repeat leg by their prefix — `stand_cells_served` 5, on the stand's own Cells (`stand::boot_cells`, a screen of 47,949 bytes in 740 lines, 5 parts of `SNAPSHOT_TEXT_BUDGET`) through `Session::run`: Cells walked in parts through the driver (`cells_is_walked_in_parts_through_the_driver`, v020-09's witness); committed cells reading their values and a cell past the viewport read in the last part; a click right after a `scroll` landing on the shown overlay scrollbar, so the walk takes `advance 5000` before its click; the lint at boot reading its measured findings — and `stand_load_page` 3, on the load page (`stand::boot_load`): a click on `load-fetch` waiting out the load `LoadNet` answers after 200 ms and `load-done` showing "Loaded" (`the_load_page_click_waits_out_its_load_and_shows_the_message`, v020-07's witness), and the page keyed with no lint finding at boot, and its rows asserted beside its load wait by the file's third test (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_load_page.rs:55-96), their Tab sequence and button keys by `stand_keyboard`, their ratios by `stand_contrast` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_cells_served.rs:94-249; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_load_page.rs:35-127 — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md, the two counts at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md)
